value: Sievert, K., Schmidt, T.S., Steffen, B. (2024). Considering technology characteristics to project future costs of direct air capture. Joule 8(4), 979-999. doi:10.1016/j.joule.2024.02.005.

Expert-interview and component experience-curve projection of DACCS costs. Loaded: first-plant sizes, TRLs, first-plant net removed cost (median, 5-95th range) and the system experience rate for liquid-solvent and solid-sorbent DAC. NOT loaded: CaO ambient weathering (no archetype), projected costs at 1 Gt, and every engineering input (capex, energy use, lifetime, capacity factor), which sit in the SI Tables S9-S25 (not held). Traps: (1) the cost is per t CO2 NET REMOVED and includes CO2 transport and storage - higher than a cost per t captured; (2) the liquid-solvent TRL is 4 on the paper's commissioning-year reading, against 6 in the archetype; (3) experience rates apply to the whole net removed cost, not capex. Locator: journal page numbers.
